### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata/src/index.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata/src/index.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **180** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cd169a02eca1c1bf751ba07f70997e80e6850777` — the merge of head `d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5` into base `33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cd169a02eca1c1bf751ba07f70997e80e6850777 && git checkout cd169a02eca1c1bf751ba07f70997e80e6850777
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8 d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5 && git checkout -B drift-repro 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8 && git merge --no-ff d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 33a31dc7b083e1a25310b0323c8cc5d796c3b4b8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts + packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts, packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts, packages/metadata/src/index.ts, packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-commits.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, .changeset/37604-platform-record-followups.md, and the three test files of the diff
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none

Read: the diff from merge-base `33a31dc7` to the head; card #37604 with claim 7197321181 and report 7199253774; the PR body; reviews 7182526807, 7179564385 and 7179776919; the head's check-runs and the failed job log. Nothing was built or run locally, so the dev's red-on-base, ablation and suite counts are the dev's readings.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Overlay census reader (L1 item 1).** The deleted private copy read any non-empty `package_id` as a package; the shared `isPlatformRecordRow` reads the `sys_metadata` sentinel as none (`storedRowColumnPackageId`).
  - The answer differs only for a row whose own column holds the sentinel and whose body carries the mark and names no package.
  - No current writer puts the sentinel in `sys_metadata.package_id`: `historySnapshotPackageColumn` and `historySnapshotPackage` write it to the history table only, and `DatabaseLoader` writes a package column only for a real package. So no reachable row changes its census answer.
  - Where it would differ, the new answer is the right one: the sentinel names no package, as the adopt-orphans filter and `storedRowColumnPackageId` already read it.
  - Unparseable and object bodies read the same as before.
- **Row rule, N5 direction (L1 item 2).** A row bound to a package by its column, with a body that keeps the mark, now passes the row rule. Nothing #37130 relied on is reopened.
  - #37130's refusal protects the package-less row the platform's registration writes; that row still has an empty column and is still refused at all three doors.
  - The row that now passes is the package's by column. In `DatabaseLoader` its slot is keyed by the column first (`storedRowPackageId`) and the written body is stamped for that slot; in the repository the write goes to the stated package's row.
  - The new version rule covers the one harmful write into such a row, the platform's version.
- **Version rule, false positives (L1 item 3).** I found no path where a package's own version is refused.
  - A refusal needs a history row with no package in its column, and a body with the mark and no package.
  - A package's version carries the package in its history column (slotted types since #32905) or in its body, and every save door strips the mark.
  - The protocol control pin restores the package's own v3.
- **Version rule, false negatives (L1 item 3).** I found none at the three doors.
  - Service `rollback`, slotted types: `intoPackageId` is `slot.packageId`, so a row bound by body stamp alone is covered too. With two slots, `rollbackSlot` still refuses the owner mismatch first, as before.
  - Service `rollback`, other types: `intoPackageId` is the existing row's column, and the version is read by `historyVersionRow`. With history untracked there is no version to restore.
  - `rollbackMetaItem` always states `packageId` (the addressed slot's, the served row's column, or `resolveOverlayPackageBinding`); `revertCommit` states the commit's package. Active-state `put` writes exactly the stated package's row.
  - A restore into the package-less row passes, as the card intends.
- **adopt-orphans (L1 item 4).** No orphan that should be adopted is left behind.
  - The filter excludes only a package-less row whose body carries the mark and names no package.
  - Only `register` with `origin: 'platform'` stamps the mark; every authoring door strips or refuses it, so an environment-authored orphan never matches.
  - The control pin adopts a package-less row whose body names a package.
  - Every later loop in `reassignOrphanedMetadata` iterates `orphans`, so the skipped row is not touched downstream.
- **`listPackageBindings` (#37187 N3).** A loader lost in the list walk is named once and not re-read. The answer is `degraded` either way, and the contract tells consumers to treat a degraded answer as unknown.
- **Spec edit (L1 item 6).** `packages/spec/src/contracts/metadata-service.ts` changes one JSDoc sentence inside `listPackageBindings`' doc. No signature, type, schema or export moves; `check:generated` is reported up to date and Lint & Repo Gates is green on the head. The sentence agrees with `readRowColumnOf` and `bindReadRowPackage`.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, is right per AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3.

- **`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`** is the correct reading; the claim's `no` was a pre-measurement estimate. The diff adds an export (`isPlatformRecordRow`), adds an optional fourth argument to an exported function, and refuses or leaves out two writes that happened before.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`** holds. No key, accepted value, metadata type, code or route changes; the refused body stays writable by saving it naming the package. A non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` and keeps its banner and disposition.
- **Changeset body** carries both declaration lines, one marker and a "What to do" line per break. The shape matches the accepted #37130 note (`.changeset/pre/37130-platform-record-restore-doors.md`). Check Changeset and Lint & Repo Gates are green.
- **`@objectstack/spec`** has no entry of its own. The edit is a doc comment and the package sits in the same `fixed` group, so it versions with the two bumped packages.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Author.** PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay author to name.
- **SQL push-down.** No new id materialisation or in-app join. The adoption filter runs over rows the method already read; the service door adds one keyed history read per non-slotted rollback.
- **`open_questions`.** Empty.
- **Dev flag: compiled 37013 / 37130 notes.** Agreed that N3 is dropped: both notes are under `.changeset/pre/` on the head, compiled by `33a31dc7`. A wording fix to a compiled CHANGELOG entry is a prose-face follow-up for the seat.
- **Dev flag: remaining body-only readers.** See N2.
- **Dev flag: model-free commit trailer.** A process deviation for the seat; no contract effect.
- **Check-runs on the head (L1 item 7), at 17:39Z.** 68 runs: 56 success, 11 skipped, 1 in progress (`Test Core (5/10)`, attempt 2 of run 45861944929, started 17:36Z).
  - Attempt 1 failed at step "Run this shard's tests" with first error `Test timed out in 5000ms` at `packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts:281` ("none set: exit 1, naming all three").
  - I judge it unrelated to this diff. The diff touches no file under `packages/cli`. The test spawns `os start` and expects a refusal before boot, under the default 5000 ms test timeout.
  - The same step and first error line appear in job 139971655655 of merge-group run 45837486482 (queue branch for PR #37513, 14:46Z), before this PR existed.
  - It is not a merge-base red: `Test Core (5/10)` is green on base `33a31dc7`. The all-green landing condition therefore still rests on attempt 2, which the seat must read before any request for approval.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`metadata-service.ts` (hit).** The corrected sentence closes #37187's N6 and holds against the code it describes. It cannot change what a consumer does; the sentence still ends by telling it to treat a degraded answer as unknown.
- **Route for item 1.** The loud refusal in the producer is sound: one rule in `@objectstack/metadata`, asked by all three doors, reusing #37130's envelope and naming the fix. It leaves the M1 attribution rule that history reads share untouched.
- **Narrowing against the published spec.** It takes no declared capability away at the consumer. No contract promised that the platform's version could become a package's item by rollback, or that adoption rebinds the platform's record.
- **Pins.** They cover the three doors named and bare, `revertCommit` with a commit that names its package (N2), the adoption with a control, and the N5 reader. The protocol pins mark the history rows by hand; the service-door pin goes through a real `register` and `unregister` with `origin: 'platform'`.
- **N1 message.** The clause now states that the re-save lasts until the platform's next registration.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit)** — `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` computes `intoPackageId` from the raw `opts.packageId` or raw column, without the sentinel normalisation the shared reader and the `DatabaseLoader` door apply.
  - On a `sys_metadata` row whose own column held `sys_metadata` and whose body is unmarked, the protocol doors would refuse a platform version "into package 'sys_metadata''s row" while the service door would pass it.
  - No current writer stores the sentinel in that column, so no reachable row is affected.
- **N2 (nit)** — the doc calls `isPlatformRecordRow` "the one reader of the fact", and the three askers it lists do ask it. `database-loader.ts` still has body-only readers (`platformRow` on the write path, `taken` and the non-slotted `platformOnly` branch of `delete`), which the PR body discloses.
  - Rows that the pre-fix adoption already rebound keep the mark under a package column and are not repaired here.
  - For a non-slotted type the withdrawal's body-only read could take such a row. Read, not measured; a follow-up card candidate.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37604-platform-record-followups`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读
- 修两处可能悄悄写错数据的地方：平台撤回自带记录（内置技能/智能体/工具）以后，再回滚时不会再把平台那一版写进某个包的数据里；「领养孤儿元数据」时不会再把平台自带的记录领走。
- 两处都先在主干上复现了问题，再修；会被拦下时给出明确的报错和改法（把那一版重新以包的名义保存即可），不影响正常回滚。
- 已经被旧版本领走的记录这次不修复，另立卡 #37656 先测量再决定。
- 要你做的：用 os-zhuang 账号批准本 PR（收窄类改动需授权批准）。契约审核 PASS 记录 7199461447，Head-sha `d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5`。

席位意见：两级审核在这个 head 上都通过，CI 全绿（唯一一次红是 CLI 包里一个与本 PR 无关的测试超时，重跑已过）；剩余小问题立卡 #37656。建议批准。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#6 · head `d96a1a97b72039e0a1ff03a582bbd2705ab5a3d5`

- Shape: draft → main, `Fixes #37604`; 13 files, +376 / −50.
- Premise measured: items 1 and 2 each reproduced on main `4e10d4bf` with a pin red there (protocol door, adopt, service door) before the fix; ablations of the version refusal, the lost-loader skip, the reader's column check and the adopt filter each turn their pins red.
- Gates: check-runs at head 58 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed (`Test Core (5/10)` attempt 1 timed out in the unrelated `packages/cli` test `start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts`, the signature seen on #37513 queue run 45837486482; attempt 2 green); dogfood battery at `d96a1a97` (488 files / 4135 tests passed, os-verify-lock VERDICT exit 0).
- Accepted deviations: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` in place of the claim's `no` (new export `isPlatformRecordRow` and an optional argument; confirmed by the contract review); N3 dropped because the 37013 and 37130 notes were compiled into `.changeset/pre/` by `33a31dc7`; commits carry the model-free co-author trailer the pre-push hook requires.
- Edits in the two files shared with in-flight #37584 / #37422: `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` only loses its private reader (import swap); `protocol-save.ts` untouched; `sys-metadata-repository.ts` one call site.
- Out of scope: contract-review nits N1 N2 and the compiled CHANGELOG wording → #37656.
- Landing: narrowing — the queue guard's narrowed leg needs an authorized APPROVED review (os-zhuang); on approval the seat lands it; `Fixes #37604` closes the card and the seat takes `pm:dispatched` off in the same stroke.
